findings.summary: Map.set keys, method receivers and for...of arrays decide a copy with operandsToPin and copy through the existing pin helpers; the receiver check includes the called body.
Engine-carrier disagreement is decided once inside commonResourceValue instead of by two call sites with different rules.
trackRetainedCaptureName reuses the cppIdentifiers tokenizer, and requireEngine uses a value's own engine companion captures.
A SpriteAtlas owner pair names the entry engine its record materializes into; the const-initializer re-read is removed.
Engine-owned parameter storage is one helper (engineParameterStorage) instead of four hand-written rules.
Completion facts share one key list for stripping and joining function storage.
requireCopiedOwnUndefinedFields takes its source value instead of two optional parameters.
Stored class-field stores share storeClassField; scene-node source kinds share convertsToSceneNode.
JSON union member choice filters document members once; property keys try jsonValueCpp before the handle and function arms.
Owned-to-plain array spreads use the per-element conversion; the plain-to-owned engine proof uses commonResourceValue.
Absent nullable resources use nullableResourceValue's default value; the retained-result element demand passes its constant.
Await results register an owned engine pair once, as a const binding.
Record types the pinned package declares never demand document storage, decided in documentRecordDemand for every caller.
withKindValueFacts copies named string facts; the metadata strings bound to the source's own storage are listed in spelledMetadataFields.
The picking-result engine rebase, the audio closed-enum write test and the literal-null shortcut reuse one helper each.
Single-handle storage and entry-engine ownership are handle-kind properties in handles.ts.
describeEngineCaptures merges its engine-only blocks; completion walkers share everyCompletion and fresh return walks share returnsOnly.
EvaluationOrder caches each node's access; requireOwnUndefinedWrite resolves its source type only for struct owners.
RegExp effect analysis indexes only references of constant symbols, the only ones it reads.
for...of array elements are read in place when the body changes no array and never reassigns the loop variable.
An own undefined written to an optional scalar field demands document storage only where the record's presence is read.
Owned pairs of entry-engine kinds name the in-scope entry engine, and conditional owned selections pick plain handles there.
Map, Set and array lookups of engine-owned handle keys borrow the engine identity instead of constructing an owner.
